changelog: Character Studio: create, preview and save the character other players see in games.
Minigolf: private multiplayer rooms, first-person movement, Adventure and Pro courses, and authoritative ball physics.
Chess: place a shared 3D board in the world and play against a friend or the computer, with time controls and rematches.
Game SDK v1: register custom multiplayer games with shared lobbies, invitations, ready checks and saved characters.
Home screen: arrange apps across pages and choose Studio, Outline or Monochrome icon packs.
Beat: Expert difficulty, walls, stacks, solo modifiers, pause controls, new tracks and improved charts and scoring.
Internal cleanup removes unused helpers, redundant state and an unused direct UI dependency.
Update the complete resource and built NUI together. Retain the server configuration; shared defaults fill missing settings.
